title: 4th BoD Meeting-RCMP Regal Year
summary: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Parleshwar held its 4th Regal Year Board meeting online on 23 Oct 2026. President Sundeep Gokhale chaired it, and 15 members attended.
description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Parleshwar held its 4th Regal Year Board meeting online on 23 Oct 2026. President Sundeep Gokhale chaired it, and 15 members attended. The 26 Sept minutes were approved.
Decisions ratified from the WhatsApp group:
Fundraising for 30 beds for Cooper Hospital at Rs 4,000 each. The revised Rs 8,850 semi-fowler bed option was held back until usability details are in.
Joining Rotary Club of Palghar’s RYPEN for 280 tribal children as Gold Co-host.
Projects reviewed:
UDAAN Interact District Conference, with RCMP as Platinum Host. About 590 attended and took the Nasha Mukt Bharat pledge. GMES and Madhavrao Bhagwat school won prizes.
Dental and eye camp that screened 1,444 students.
Navratri Dandiya night.
Upcoming events: Kojagiri Night (24 Oct), Parleshwar Katta (31 Oct), Diwali (4 Nov), eMagazine Edition 5, and Culture Fest (12–13 Dec).
